_about: Hand rules: the cards you take into battle.
sections maps a card type to its section. Augments are passive buffs and gear is equipped, so neither goes in the Hand.
Minion slots come from the class's minion stat (classes.json). duplicates: whether a section can hold more than one copy of the same card.

Formations: one starting formation (active when the battle begins) plus reserves you can switch to during battle. formationSwitchAP is the action-point cost to switch: a placeholder until battles are built.
